# `aube recursive`

- **Usage:** `aube recursive [ARGS]…`
- **Aliases:** `multi`, `m`

Run a supported command across workspace packages

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/workspaces) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[ARGS]…`** — Command and arguments to run recursively across workspace packages
